items.title: Google Warns of New PROMPTFLUX Malware Using Gemini API to Rewrite its Own Source Code
items.description: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) has unveiled details of an experimental malware family called PROMPTFLUX, which leverages the company’s Gemini AI API to dynamically rewrite its own code, marking a chilling evolution in AI-assisted cyber threats. items.title: SonicWall Confirms State-Sponsored Hackers Behind September Cloud Backup Breach
items.description: SonicWall has formally implicated state-sponsored threat actors as behind the September security breach that led to the unauthorized exposure of firewall configuration backup files. items.title: Chrome Emergency Update to Patch Multiple Vulnerabilities that Enable Remote Code Execution
items.description: Google has rolled out an urgent security patch for its Chrome browser, addressing five vulnerabilities that could enable attackers to execute malicious code remotely. The update, version 142.0.7444.134/.135 for Windows, 142.0.7444.135 for macOS, and 142.0.7444.134 for Linux, targets critical flaws in core components like WebGPU and the V8 JavaScript engine. items.title: APT 'Bronze Butler' Exploits Zero-Day to Root Japan Orgs
items.description: A critical security issue in a popular endpoint manager (CVE-2025-61932) allowed Chinese state-sponsored attackers to backdoor Japanese businesses.
